newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB doesn't exclude lower interest rates - Roth. [CORRECTED 14:41 GMT]
newsitem.headline: SNB doesn't exclude lower interest rates - Roth. [CORRECTED 14:41 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline too make clear that Roth was referring to money market interest rates and not the Swiss doscount rate).
Swiss National Bank vice chairman Jean-Pierre Roth said that the SNB was not happy with the current Swiss franc exchange rate.
"We are uncomfortable with the exchange rate as it is right now," he said.
"The message to the banks is, we are adding liquidity... We are not ruling out lower interest rates," he said, when asked specifically if there could be a cut in the discount rate soon.
"I cannot tell you what is going to happen tomorrow," he added.
